name: Nagato (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nagato city emblem in blue: a stylised bird-like swoosh of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nagato, a city in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 November 2005; the emblem dates from 30 September 2005.

features.role: Nagato city emblem — a stylised bird-like swoosh of curved strokes
